---
title: Training Overview
---

Training starts from the same trajectory artifacts used for debugging and
evaluation. Treat data generation, filtering, conversion, training, serving,
and evaluation as separate reproducible stages.


### Choose a training guide

| Goal | Guide |
| --- | --- |
| Convert trajectories and launch MS-Swift | [Supervised fine-tuning](04-sft.qmd) |
| Run GRPO or IGPO through AReaL | [RL with AReaL](02-rl-areal.qmd) |
| Run synchronous or asynchronous RL through slime | [RL with slime](03-rl-slime.qmd) |

### Supervised fine-tuning

The SFT scripts under `scripts/sft/` cover two distinct stages:

| Stage | Entry point |
| --- | --- |
| Convert trajectory format | `scripts/sft/sft_convert.sh` |
| Launch MS-Swift training | `scripts/sft/sft_train.sh` and `sft_training.yaml` |

Before a full training job, inspect converted samples and resolve the generated
training command with a dry run. The detailed sequence is covered in the
[SFT guide](04-sft.qmd).

```bash
python -m searcherkit.training.sft \
  --config scripts/sft/sft_training.yaml \
  --dry-run
```

Keep environment-specific model paths, datasets, output directories, and
reporting credentials in environment variables. Keep semantic training choices
such as template, loss scale, context length, optimizer settings, and
distributed strategy in versioned YAML.

### Reinforcement learning

The `scripts/areal/` and `scripts/slime/` directories are framework adapters,
while reusable reward and training-agent logic belongs in
`searcherkit.training`. Document each experiment with the base model, reward
definition, rollout config, dataset revision, framework revision, and produced
checkpoint. See the [AReaL](02-rl-areal.qmd) and [slime](03-rl-slime.qmd) guides for
their distinct ownership boundaries and launch paths.

### Evaluate a checkpoint

Serve the checkpoint behind an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, then point the
existing agent configuration at the served model:

```yaml
agent:
  llm_client:
    type: openai
    model: /path/to/checkpoint
    api_key: EMPTY
    base_url: http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1
```

SearcherKit agents are reusable across base models and trained checkpoints: the agent, parser, tools, sources, dataset, and runtime behavior remain defined through config, while the model and endpoint can be changed independently. Use the same config to inspect the composed setup, run the checkpoint over a dataset, and evaluate the saved trajectories. See [Run and evaluate SearchAgent](../01-searching/04-batch-run-and-evaluate.qmd) for the complete commands and evaluation options.
